_about: Bench fixture (2026-10-01, the concept-layer plan): a licensed therapist. The trade's concept default is PLAIN: no theme, nothing renamed, clarity and craft carry the page. Fictional business; nothing here is a real person.
owner_brief: I'm a licensed clinical therapist in Columbus. I see adults for anxiety, life transitions and couples work, in person and by video. I want the site to feel calm and trustworthy, never gimmicky. People should know what a first session is like, what it costs, and how to book a free 15 minute call. I take two insurance plans and offer a sliding scale.
